== Biography ==
Mary was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1675|William Glasgow]] and [[Glendinning-340|Nancy Glendinning]].
<ref name="s">[[Space:A_Brief_Memorial_of_the_Deceased_Members_of_the_Glendinning_Family]]</ref>

The family moved to Ohio, United States.

=== Estimated birth year ===
In the list of eight children in the Glendinning book, they appear to be the males listed chronologically, and then the females listed chronologically. If that is correct, it implies Mary was the eldest child. Estimated birth year 1824 (2 years before otherwise eldest child) on this basis.


The unsigned 1903 <i>A Brief Memorial of the Deceased Members of the Glendinning Family</i>, under “Glasgow–Glendinning Family,” describes Nancy as the elder’s fifth daughter, born in April 1803, whose mother was Mary Bell. It says [[Glendinning-340|Nancy]] married [[Glasgow-1675|William Glasgow]] of Killycorragh and names five sons—[[Glasgow-3148|Henry Cunningham]], Adam, [[Glasgow-3149|Isaac Watts]], [[Glasgow-3150|Benjamin]] and [[Glasgow-2825|Alexander Flemming]]—and three daughters—[[Glasgow-3158|Mary]], [[Glasgow-3146|Matilda]] and [[Glasgow-3147|Jane]]. It records Nancy’s death at Belle Center on 20 March 1890, aged 87. The passage supplies no father or other kin for William.<ref name="Glendinning1903">Unsigned, <i>A Brief Memorial of the Deceased Members of the Glendinning Family</i> (1903), “Glasgow–Glendinning Family,” PDF page 17 (no printed page number), [https://glendinning.name/history/irish_glendinning.pdf#page=17 original booklet]; page and 1903 cover visually checked 24 October 2026.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Father and family identification ===

The relationship to [[Glasgow-1675|William Glasgow]] is assessed at 97% (confident). Mary represents the record-defined daughter in the memorial itself, with no separately claimed adult identity to bridge. The book does not date her birth: the circa-1824 estimate inferred from the order of names remains uncertain. The booklet explicitly names the children, but each identification with a later adult must be assessed separately. The WikiTree Space account of this booklet is derivative of the same family tradition, not a second independent witness. This assessment concerns the paternal link; it does not establish further ancestry for William or resolve every maternal or vital detail.
